title: Protein expression in Bacillus subtilis
author: Kristoffer Bach Falkenberg
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdmui46w

steps.title: Prepare Na2MoO4 stock solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a stock solution of 2.0g/L Na2MoO4 and sterilize it by filtration.

steps.title: Prepare trace metal solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a trace metal solution consisting of 4.48g/L MnSO4·H2O, 3.33g/L FeCl3·6H2O, 0.625g/L CuSO4·5H2O, and 7.12g/L ZnSO4·7H2O, then sterilize by filtration.

steps.title: Prepare expression media
steps.instruction: Prepare the expression media in a blue cap bottle using MQ water and the specified components.

substeps.instruction: Fill a blue cap bottle to ~80% of the desired final volume with MQ water.
Add a magnetic stirrer to the bottle, place it on a stirring plate, and turn on stirring to ensure mixing.

Add the following components: 40g/L yeast extract, 1.3g/L MgSO4·7H2O, 50g/L maltodextrin (DE ~ 12), 20g/L NaH2PO4·2H2O, 6.7mL/L of the 2.0g/L Na2MoO4 stock solution, 6.7mL/L trace metal solution, and 100μL/L Pluronic L-61.
Ensure all ingredients are fully dissolved.
Add MQ water to reach the desired final volume.

steps.title: Sterilize and store media
steps.instruction: Sterilize the media by filtration and store at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Use a 0.45μM vacuum bottle top filter (be prepared to use several filters per liter as the media clogs easily).
Store the sterilized media at 4 °C until needed.

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate and grow the expression strain overnight.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 3 mL to 50 mL of LB media with a single colony of the expression strain in a 24-deepwell plate, falcon tube, or shake flask.
Ensure the culture is not incubated for longer than 16:00:00 to maintain reproducibility.

steps.title: Inoculate expression culture
steps.instruction: Prepare the expression culture in the chosen vessel.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the desired volume of expression media in the desired vessel (note: 24-deepwell plates with large shaking amplitude or CSTRs are recommended over shake flasks for higher titers).
Inoculate the expression media to an OD600 of 0.1.

steps.title: Incubate expression culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture under specific temperature and shaking conditions.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 20 °C with 250 RPM shaking for between 48:00:00 and 72:00:00.

steps.title: Harvest culture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture to harvest the cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Optional: Centrifuge the resulting supernatant at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 30 minutes to remove cell debris and contaminants.

steps.title: Store samples
steps.instruction: Maintain sample stability during and after processing.

substeps.instruction: Keep the sample on ice during handling.
